behavior: GW-44..GW-57 reuse the existing CI, OIDC, S1 deploy worker, Live State, governed session and governed task authorities; candidate evaluation does not deploy or mutate S1.
Immutable CI/deployment evidence is identity-bound rather than expired by arbitrary age; mutable Live State must satisfy its existing freshness policy.
Push admission carries the exact authorizing MCP CI run to the deployment route and S1 worker; workflow_dispatch remains an explicit manual admission path as preserved by GWC-PRE-C1.

S1 deployment attestations are emitted as schema version 2 with deterministic attestation id and bounded admission evidence; historical schema version 1 attestations remain readable with admission=null and are never reinterpreted as V2 proof.
GW-52 requires one exact SHA, one deploy job across GW-47/48/49/50/51, the exact GW-45 CI run referenced by the V2 push attestation, current fully-aligned Live State and no contradictions.

GW-55 and GW-57 only produce EffectPlans targeting existing mcp_acknowledge_governed_context and mcp_transition_governed_task authorities; GW-57 binds DEPLOYING and runtimeRevision in one governed task transition.
